name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション ギロロロボMk-II
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Giroro Robo Mk-II

description.ja: 大砲やミサイルなど全身武器だらけ“ギロロロボMk-II”登場。
description.en: Introducing the “Giroro Robo Mk-II”, which is full of weapons such as cannons and missiles.

description.ja: ロボ形態からタンク形態へ変形。
description.en: Transforms from robot form to tank form.

description.ja: ロボに乗り込むギロロ伍長も手足が可動。
description.en: Corporal Giroro who rides the robot also has movable limbs.

description.ja: ギロロ伍長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
description.en: Corporal Giroro can be placed on a saucer that also serves as the robot's cockpit.
